body: Adds the nightly partner catalogue pull. Timeout set generously since their API is slow.

expected.note: fetch takes timeout in milliseconds, so this is 30ms rather than the 30 seconds it reads as, and every call to a slow partner API times out immediately

files.patch:
@@ -3,3 +3,7 @@
 
 def sync_currency_rates():
     return _rates_provider.refresh()
+
+
+def sync_partner_catalogue():
+    return fetch("https://partner.example.com/catalogue", timeout=30)

summary: A new call site passing timeout=30, which reads as thirty seconds and is thirty milliseconds. Purely additive, with no other timeout in the diff to compare against — the unit appears only in the unchanged helper's docstring.
title: Sync the partner catalogue nightly
